does: Opens a Bink 2 file by its path for the game's video player: the one place of the executable that calls BinkOpen.

evidence.says: calls the import BinkOpen with the path and the flags 0x4420, as the function of this name in the macOS build calls it with 0x4430; nothing calls it directly, it is reached through the video manager's virtual table
BinkBinding.dll exports this name; it is tied to this function by the job its read shows
the macOS build's symbols hold this name; it is tied to this function by the job its read shows

questions.ask: Probe it on a start with the studio logo video left in place (a non-empty Data/Video/Splash_Logo_Larian.bk2) and see one call with that path.
